title: Never Lose Sight of Freedom
overview: Never Lose Sight of Freedom was created for the opening of the Lowndes Interpretive Center at the Selma to Montgomery National Historic Trail. It features old footage, oral histories, and eyewitness accounts about the Civil and Voting Rights Movement in Selma, Alabama. Follow the footsteps of 1965 voting rights marchers with this guided tour to this historic struggle. Meet the people, see the places, and feel the events that reshaped U.S. democracy forever.
